newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli soldier killed in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier killed in south Lebanon.

text.p: One Israeli soldier was killed and two others were wounded on Friday in a guerrilla attack in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

Two Arab guerrillas were killed on Thursday night when Israeli helicopters and artillery gunners fired at a group of fighters trying to infiltrate the zone, the sources with the Israeli-backed South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia added.

In the morning attack, the guerrillas fired mortar bombs at the Dabsheh post on the edge of the Israeli-held zone, the SLA sources said. One soldier was killed and two wounded as a result of the bombardment.
The Israeli fatality raised to five the number of Israeli soldiers killed in south Lebanon this year. Last year, 27 Israeli soldiers died in Lebanon fighting.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah claimed responsibility for the assault.

In the night-time incident, Israeli helicopters fired rockets and heavy machineguns and gunners fired artillery shells at a group of guerrillas near the market town of Nabatiyeh facing Dabsheh, killing two of them.
Some artillery shells slammed into the market town, causing damage but no casualties, Lebanse security sources said.
Hizbollah (Party of God) is fighting to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 SLA militiamen from the south Lebanon zone set up to prevent guerrilla attacks on northern Israel.
